title: Later Mughals Rafi Ud Darajat
definition: Rafi-ud-Darajat was the 10th Mughal Emperor who reigned for a brief period in 1719, serving as a puppet ruler under the control of the Sayyid Brothers.
importanceInUpsc: Essential for understanding the 'Era of Puppet Emperors' and the peak of the Sayyid Brothers' influence (Kingmakers) in the decline of the Mughal Empire.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Later Mughals Rafi Ud Darajat.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
